note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Minnesota 94th Legislature. One file serves both Minnesota sessions in scope (the 2025-2026 regular session, LegiScan 2151, and the 2025 First Special Session, LegiScan 2217) because LegiScan people_ids are stable across sessions. Mapped entries are the proposer's 47 matches, each checked by hand, plus one member the proposer cannot reach. Minnesota nests House districts nnA and nnB inside Senate district nn, which is how every sitting representative running for the Senate was corroborated. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null. Refreshed 2026-09-05 after the full House and Senate November 2026 roster campaign: the resolver was re-run at --scope-from 2026-08-01 and all 161 proposals were reviewed by hand. Every proposal's seat agrees with the LegiScan district, either the same seat or a sitting representative moving up to the Senate district their House district nests inside. Four matches were weaker name variants on the same seat and were accepted: Ronald/Ron Latz, Joshua/Josh Heintzeman, Cal/Calvin Bahr and Pete/Peter Johnson. Two members the proposer cannot reach were added by hand because LegiScan holds the legal first name while the ballot carries the working name: Alicia/Liish Kozlowski (HD-008B) and Andrew/Andy Smith (HD-025B). Six surname collisions on other seats were rejected on the seat: Carla Nelson, Tou Xiong, Nicole Mitchell, Patti Anderson, Bruce Anderson and James Carlson. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null.
